_comment: Allowlist of expected Supabase linter findings that have been reviewed and accepted. Any finding NOT in this list — especially anything related to RLS (missing/disabled/permissive policies) or PII exposure — will fail the CI security check. To add a new entry, include the linter rule `name` (e.g. 'security_definer_view') and the fully qualified object the warning refers to, taken from the linter `metadata`.

allowed.name: function_search_path_mutable
allowed.reason: Acceptable — all our SECURITY DEFINER functions explicitly SET search_path = public.

allowed.name: 0028_anon_security_definer_function_executable
allowed.reason: Helper + RPC functions (has_role, is_swap_participant, place_point_order, etc.) intentionally use SECURITY DEFINER to enforce server-side rules. Reviewed 2026-04-28.

allowed.name: 0029_authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
allowed.reason: Same as above — signed-in users invoke these RPCs by design. Reviewed 2026-04-28.

_blockedCategories._comment: These linter rule names ALWAYS fail the build, even if listed above. They map to RLS / PII exposure issues we never want to silently allow.
